summary: EDENOR, an Argentine electric utility, filed a Form 6-K solely to report its condensed interim financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026, as approved by the Board of Directors. The filing discloses quarterly profit, equity breakdown, and share capital composition by class (A, B, C), with Class B shares listed on NYSE via ADSs and BYMA. It notes a 51% controlling stake held by Empresa de Energía del Cono Sur S.A. and treasury shares. No transaction, shareholder proposal, or special event is disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special situation.
